name: .NET Local Deploy via Self-Hosted Runner

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main  # Triggers when you push to the main branch

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: self-hosted  # <--- THIS tells GitHub to send the job to your Ubuntu machine!

    steps:
    # 1. Pull the fresh code into the runner folder
    - name: Checkout Source Code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    # 2. Build and publish the app locally on the Ubuntu server
    - name: Build & Publish App
      run: |
        dotnet restore
        dotnet publish -c Release -o ./publish

    # 3. Clean out old production files and copy new ones
    - name: Move Files to Production Directory
      run: |
        sudo cp -r ./publish/* /var/www/app4/

    # 4. Restart your systemd app1 service safely
    - name: Restart Application runtime
      run: |
        sudo systemctl restart app4
